text: In this game you share one five hundred and twelve kilobit line between a whole shop of customers.
On that line, this demo would take about sixteen minutes to download.
Brazilian LAN House 2003. Six beige PCs, a foosball table, and a neighbourhood that wants to play.
You run the tabs, the power and the machines, and when a PC freezes, you fix it from the network monitor.
The whole demo is a hundred and fifty-eight megabytes, and it ships for Windows, Mac and Linux.
